text:
Clara M: Quick sync — need final copy for the webinar landing + a short benchmark post vs managed cloud endpoints. Focus on cost vs latency story. Can we iterate?
Mike L: I can do 2 hero lines and 3 rebut bullets. Putting options below.
Anya S: please include a single-sentence TL;DR that PMs can paste into decks. keep it <25 words.
Sam R: also need a routing note: inbound leads asking about "we already use cloud provider X — why move?" quick answer pls.
Devon K: Here are suggested hero lines:

1) "Serve LLMs at cloud-like scale with far lower per-token cost and predictable latency." 
2) "Production-first inference: engineered for steady latency, not just peak throughput."

Mike L: Rebut bullets (short):
- "Cloud APIs are simple but opaque — we give visible unit economics + knobs." 
- "Self-hosted infra hits ops debt; Redwood is 'bring-your-network' with platform ops." 
- "Dedicated capacity avoids noisy neighbors + unpredictable tail latency." 

Anya S: TL;DR suggestions:
- "Redwood: predictable latency, transparent cost, deploy anywhere."
- "Ship LLM features faster with predictable economics." 

Sam R: Quick inbound scripting:
Customer: "Why not just use provider X's managed endpoint?"
Reply: "Managed APIs get you started; Redwood turns prototypes into predictable production — think 3–5x cost reductions via batching/cache + SLA-backed capacity when you scale." 

Devon K: Flagging risky claims: don't promise "3–5x" in public copy without benchmarking context. Add "typical" or "for our reference benchmark" if we keep numbers.

Mike L: Micro post draft (LinkedIn):
```
Benchmarked: managed endpoints vs. Redwood Dedicated.
Result: Same latencies at half the token cost, plus SLA-backed capacity.
Want the methodology? We'll publish the dataset & runbook at the webinar. #inference #LLMops
```

Anya S: Alternative tweet-length:
"Cut inference cost, keep latency — Redwood gives predictable performance across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Webinar + benchmarks next Wed."

Jessica (marketing-bot): Noting SEO hooks: use keywords "LLM inference", "inference cost", "latency SLO", "dedicated GPU pool" in the landing. Also add a link to the benchmark methodology page when live. 

Clara M: Love these. Devon — update numbers to "typical reductions" and add a short caveat line. Mike — can you shorten hero line 1 to one clause? 

Mike L: New hero 1: "Cloud-scale inference, predictable latency." 

Devon K: Caveat suggestion: "Results vary by model, sequence length, and workload; see benchmark notes for details." 

Sam R: Final inbound script for SDRs (one-liner):
"We help teams move from pilot to SLA-backed production with better unit economics and predictable latency — can I share the benchmark deck?"

Anya S: I'm running an A/B of hero 1 vs hero 2 on the landing. We'll push variant A (Mike's new hero) to 50% and measure CTR + signups. 

Clara M: Great. Action items:
- Mike: finalize hero + 3 bullets (due EOD) 
- Devon: add conservative language for numbers (due EOD)
- Jessica: prep SEO and add UTM tags for variants (due tomorrow)
- Sam: short SDR script and FAQ doc (due tomorrow)

Mike L: On it. 

Devon K: Will drop the wording and add the benchmark caveat. 

Jessica (marketing-bot): Added UTM template to the PRD doc: https://redwood.internal/marketing/prd

Clara M: Thanks team — let's reconvene after the landing variant metrics come in. :rocket:
